messages:
kai: FYI post-canary we saw ~0.28% failures in eu1 embeddings. root cause looks like a quant/KV cache type mismatch. planning a hotfix in the late window and requesting expedited approvals.
jen (oncall): paste the minimal log and rollback plan please. we need clear thresholds.
kai: log snippet:
```
ERROR embeddings-eu1: kvcache lookup type mismatch id=0x3a
   at quant/lookup.go:128
```
rollback = `/deploy rollback embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-embed-41` (or pin previous sha). perf impact: p50 +0.2ms in microbench.
maria chen: relnotes stub ready: "hotfix: defensive kvcache type-check + cache regen for embeddings-eu1". will open PR once SRE approves.
sre-bot: SRE requested thresholds: compressed canary because late window. propose 5% for 5m smoke, then 50% for 8m, then 100% if green. rollback triggers: error rate >0.6% OR p95 latency +15% OR sustained cpu >70% for 2m.
ops-liaison: product signoff required before final ramp. tagging product via email.
kai: proposed deploy command:
```
/deploy embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-45 --pin --expedite --canary=5% --smoke=5m
```
release-bot: Deployment request created by kai for service=embeddings-eu1 version=v2026-03-hotfix-45 image=sha256:beefcafe. Approvers notified.
jen (oncall): SRE approved thresholds. product emailed — waiting ack.
ops-liaison: product ack received, conditional on relnotes PR. maria, can you push relnotes now?
maria chen: PR opened and linked: https://go/relnotes/PR-1502. includes revert steps and contact for post-deploy.
release-bot: canary started at 5829002485. logs: https://go/logs/deploy/5829002468
sre-bot: 5m canary results: error rate 0.03%, p95 +0.1ms. green. ramping to 50% for 8m.
kai: bumping to 50% now.
sre-bot: 6m into 50%: error 0.05%, latency stable. proceeding to 100% over 6m.
release-bot: final ramp complete at 5829002519. traffic now at 100%.
jen (oncall): marking expedited approval in thread. rollback command pinned above. will monitor for 30m and escalate if thresholds breach.
maria chen: relnotes merged and sent to customers in late-window digest.
ops-liaison: closing approval loop. thanks team. will open follow-up if any regression observed. :thumbsup:
